'''H2-WF''' was a "hunter-seeker" [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] from [[Nathema]] refurbished for use by [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utilized technology from Nathema's original inhabitants.<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
H2-WF appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as an uncommon companion drop from the flashpoint "The Nathema Conspiracy".<ref name="Nathema" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
